caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metallic object with a rusted, mottled brown and gray surface hanging vertically against a plain, light beige background. At the top of the cylinder, there is a thick, dark metal loop forming a hook for hanging. The cylinder features two cut-out circular openings along its vertical side, both revealing an inner white area with some peeling or chipped paint. To the right side of the cylinder, near the center, there is a small yellow, rounded object partially sticking out, attached to the surface. Extending diagonally from the lower right side of the cylinder is a single, straight, dark rod. At the base, a similarly textured, rusted cylindrical section is attached horizontally and includes two large circular openings facing forward.
title: Spice Sifter
